subject: Intro call — availability & timezone check (Andrea Garcia)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Andrea Garcia <andrea.garcia@gmail.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call — availability & timezone check (Andrea Garcia)

Hi Andrea,

Thanks for applying to the Backend Engineer role at Redwood Inference — I’m Rachel from Talent Acquisition. We’d love to do a 30-minute phone screen to learn more about your background and interests and to share next steps.

Are you available for any of these 30-minute windows? I’ve listed times in PDT (my timezone) with the equivalent CEST times for you:

- Tue 25 May, 9:00–9:30 PDT / Tue 25 May, 18:00–18:30 CEST
- Tue 25 May, 11:00–11:30 PDT / Tue 25 May, 20:00–20:30 CEST
- Wed 26 May, 8:30–9:00 PDT / Wed 26 May, 17:30–18:00 CEST

If none of those work, send a couple of times that suit you (CEST is fine) and we’ll try to accommodate. The call will be with Markus Klein (hiring manager) and myself will be on the invite. Please let me know the best phone number to reach you, or I can send a calendar invite with a dial-in link.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
ATTACHMENT: Redwood-interview-prep.pdf (stubble, 12 KB)

Phone: +34 612 345 678
A small preference for Tue if Markus is available.

Best regards,
Andrea
